339-677-5295-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-5295-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2393-4279-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

225-1556-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-1556-2645-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-792-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-792-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

465-585-3742-4068-4251.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
465-585-3742-4068-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-3025-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-3025-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4268-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4268-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1172-4271.easyPrerequisites: You control a legendary creature or planeswalker.
1172-4271.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Jaya's Immolating Inferno by paying {R}{R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage to up to three targets.
1172-4271.notes: The more life you have, the more damage you will deal. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Jaya's Immolating Inferno.

856-2921-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

632-1903-3621-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1903-3621-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

1687-5972-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-5972-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1409-5418-6441.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve the Exhibition Magician trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1660-4094-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1660-4094-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Natural Affinity
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

11-121-4872-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-4872-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Warp spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Warp spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Warp and returning the original Time Warp to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Warp from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

539-5411-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3652-3698-4053-6989.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Ornithopter enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

224-277-765-1772.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Guildless Commons
Holding priority, activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2523-3967-5561.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

950-1432-4639.notablePrerequisites: Fatestitcher and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
950-1432-4639.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Fatestitcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Ioreth of the Healing House triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

5173-5231-5258-5618.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {R}.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

658-2906-3544-4050-5751.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
658-2906-3544-4050-5751.description:
Cast Auramancer from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {W} and discarding Urza's Saga.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Urza's Saga from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auramancer, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

893-1270-1651.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Myrs, you may use Myr Turbine's second ability to put all Myrs from your library onto the battlefield and/or untap any other artifact(s) you control.

293-1379-3698-5220.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Narcomoeba, targeting yourself.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Narcomoeba enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

864-2034-2596-5284.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
864-2034-2596-5284.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards in their graveyards, sacrifice all creatures they control, then put all cards exiled this way onto the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Bala Ged Recovery // Bala Ged Sanctuary

1065-3884-4514-5088-5195.notablePrerequisites: Your storm count is at least two.
1065-3884-4514-5088-5195.description:
Cast Chatterstorm by paying {1}{G}.
Chatterstorm's storm ability triggers, creating a copy of Chatterstorm for each spell you've cast previously this turn.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each Chatterstorm, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Resolve each Chatterstorm, creating that many 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Cast Regrowth by paying {1}{G} and tapping two Squirrel tokens, targeting Chatterstorm.
Regrowth's conspire ability triggers, creating a copy of Regrowth targeting Bala Ged Recovery.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Regrowths, returning Chatterstorm and Bala Ged Recovery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-4 one time.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrifcing them, adding {2}{G}.
Cast Bala Ged Recovery by paying {2}{G} and tapping two Squirrel tokens, targeting Chatterstorm.
Bala Ged Recovery's conspire ability triggers, creating a copy of Bala Ged Recovery targeting Regrowth.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bala Ged Recoveries, returning Chatterstorm and Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature and Treasure tokens, you may substitute any other green instant and/or sorcery spells for Chatterstorm.

1765-2232-3000-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have an Aura card in hand with mana value one or less.
You control an Aura with mana value one or less.
You have enough mana available to cast the Aura in hand.
1765-2232-3000-4050.description:
Cast an Aura with mana value one or less by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control.
The Aura enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Chishiro.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return any other Aura with mana value one or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

803-1303-1409-2743.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Biovisionary.
"Zombie" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1303-1409-2743.description:
Activate Biovisionary by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Biovisionary enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator and Necroduality.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing itself and Biovisionary.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Repeat steps 1-4 two additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

313-2034-2479.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback, returning Magus of the Coffers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Tap Magus of the Coffers adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Sacrifice Magus of the Coffers to Ashnod's Altar adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
